title: From Iraq to Yemen: How Iran-linked groups are putting Saudi energy routes under pressure

The attack has increased pressure on Iraq and raised global supply concerns. Houthi rebels in Yemen have also advanced along the Red Sea route. These events disrupt major energy and shipping routes worldwide.

title: Harvard University has a 'September message' for all international students
content: Harvard University has alerted international students about significant F-1 and J-1 visa rule changes. New Department of Homeland Security rules replace the duration of status system with fixed visa end dates. Students re-entering the US after September 15 will face stricter limits and new visa frameworks. Those already in the US before this date will generally retain current protections and benefits.

title: After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images

The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: Brics nations to have a common currency? Here’s what MEA said
content: Brics nations are discussing local currency trade settlements to reduce transaction costs. There is currently no proposal for a common Brics currency among member states. This initiative aims to complement existing global payment systems and improve trade efficiency. Leaders also addressed trade barriers and the need for a strong WTO. Discussions followed eight months of work under India's Brics chairship.

title: Trump removed protections from 2.93 million acres; land now open to mining claims

The move has drawn criticism from conservation groups and advocates.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35m mansion: Why are neighbours worried about lake views?

A section of the fence extending toward the beach was later scrapped. title: Which countries are home to the largest number of Indian migrants?
content: United Arab Emirates and the United States host the largest Indian-born populations abroad. Saudi Arabia and Pakistan follow with significant numbers of Indian emigrants. Kuwait, the United Kingdom, and Canada also have substantial Indian communities. Australia, Oman, and Qatar are other key destinations for Indian migrants. These figures highlight the Gulf's significant role in Indian overseas migration.

title: Russia’s new drone strategy: How jet-powered Gerans are changing the economics of warfare
